primary_estimator: mean across parents of each parent's arithmetic mean over three frozen training-seed losses
ensemble: separate descriptive prediction-ensemble losses; never substitute for seed-mean losses

multiplicity.primary_scope: pooled TEST raw seed-mean loss; batch-specific and clipped analyses are descriptive replication/sensitivity only

comparisons.decision: two-sided adjusted CI excludes zero; report direction
two-sided adjusted CI excludes zero; report direction
two-sided adjusted CI excludes zero; report direction

comparisons.direction: positive supports at least 80 percent retained incremental gain
comparisons.decision: adjusted one-sided lower contrast bound>0 and positive stable K32 gain denominator

retention.ratio_validity: denominator point>0 and adjusted two-sided denominator CI lower>0
retention.resampling: same parent draws for numerator and denominator; never bootstrap separately
retention.zero_denominator_draws: ratio unavailable if any exact zero denominator draw; no draw deletion
retention.nonpositive_denominator_draws: report count; retain all nonzero draws unconditionally for ratio quantiles

pvalues.method: null-centered paired parent bootstrap with plus-one correction
pvalues.decision_authority: prespecified percentile confidence bounds; centered-bootstrap p-values are approximate companions, not an override

batch_consistency: Report A/B point directions, adjusted bounds and pooled result. No extra confirmatory claim from picking a batch. Opposite batch directions qualify pooled interpretation; consistency alone does not imply significance.
fail_closed: physics loss varies across seed slots
truth_policy: This evaluator consumes per-parent loss arrays already formed by the authorized evaluation stage. It never opens truth fields or prediction images and performs no training or physical solves.
